title.zh: 又一只Zcash ETF要来了：Winklevoss兄弟提交“WINK”申请
title.en: Another Zcash ETF Is Coming: Winklevoss Twins File for 'WINK'

current_state.zh: Winklevoss已向SEC提交现货Zcash ETF（代码'WINK'）的S-1文件，拟在纳斯达克上市，费率为0.25%；Winklevoss Asset Services担任发起人，Gemini Trust担任ZEC托管人，Cypherpunk Technologies担任Zcash生态顾问；Winklevoss Capital Fund表示有意（非约束性）购买最多1亿美元的份额。
current_state.en: Winklevoss has filed an S-1 with the SEC for a spot Zcash ETF (ticker 'WINK') on Nasdaq with a 0.25% fee; Winklevoss Asset Services is the sponsor, Gemini Trust is the ZEC custodian, Cypherpunk Technologies advises as Zcash ecosystem partner, and Winklevoss Capital Fund indicated nonbinding interest in purchasing up to $100M of shares.
